transcript: Speaker A: Everyday you don't practice speaking English is a day you stay exactly where you are. I'm Loora, your AI English tutor, and I'm here to make sure that doesn't happen. With me, you get real conversations anytime anywhere. No scheduling, no awkwardness. Just you and me talking. I give you instant feedback on your mistakes, not after the conversation, during it. So your brain connects the correction to the moment and you actually remember it next time. Five minutes a day is enough to start feeling the difference. 10 minutes and you'll wonder why you waited this long. Let's practice together right now.
